metadata.title: Singular Kähler-Ricci solitons and complete gradient shrinking Kähler-Ricci solitons on non-compact manifolds
metadata.abstract: We construct a class of complete gradient shrinking Kähler-Ricci solitons on non-compact toric manifolds by exhausting a family of singular Kähler-Ricci solitons associated to multiple divisors. The construction method will be also extended on non-compact $\mathbf G$-manifolds.
